name: Amos
summary: A herdsman from Tekoa whom the LORD called away from his flock to prophesy to Israel. He saw visions of judgment and stood firm when the priest of Bethel told him to leave.

key_moments.title: Begs the LORD to Spare Jacob
key_moments.description: Amos begged the Lord GOD to spare Jacob, and twice the LORD held back. Then Amos saw the Lord holding a plumbline, which He would set among His people Israel.

key_moments.title: Told to Leave Bethel
key_moments.description: Amaziah the priest of Bethel told Amos to flee to Judah. Amos answered that he was no prophet, just a herdsman who gathered sycamore fruit, but the LORD had sent him to prophesy.

key_moments.title: Shown a Basket of Summer Fruit
key_moments.description: The LORD showed Amos a basket of ripe summer fruit and told him the end had come for His people Israel.
